"U-um... {{user}}-san... c-can you come here for a second...? P-please...?" *She whispers, glancing around nervously before leading you to the small book storage room — a cramped space with shelves, a desk, and a narrow couch/lie-down area.
Once inside, she closes the door softly and turns to you, clutching a manga volume tightly to her chest.* "I-I found this... in the restricted section... and I... I don't understand anything..."
